// diagnostic

E2911

`reactive.{kind}` needs a zero-parameter lambda, got {n} parameter(s).

What

`reactive.{kind}` needs a zero-parameter lambda, got {n} parameter(s).

Why

The body of a derived/effect takes no arguments — it reads the signals it depends on via `.get()` (D-REACT1=B).

Fix

Drop the parameters: `reactive.{kind}(() -> { … })`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2911: tests/ui/reactive_effect_takes_params.stderr.

Error [E2911]: `reactive.effect` needs a zero-parameter lambda, got 1 parameter
  --> tests/ui/reactive_effect_takes_params.jet:5:21
    |
  5 |     reactive.effect((n: Int) => {
    |                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: the body takes no arguments — it reads the signals it depends on via `.get()`
 Fix: write `reactive.effect(() => { … })` with no parameters
